faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District & Sessions Judge, Chamba Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District & Sessions Judge, Chamba Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 2 Clerks (promotional quota) from amongst Process Servers, 1 Clerks (promotional quota) from amongst other Class-IV employees.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District & Sessions Judge, Chamba Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Format printed in the advertisement notice (page 1)) and send it to Office of the District & Sessions Judge, Chamba, District Chamba-HP, by through proper channel, to reach by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay amount not printed; plus usual allowances as admissible under the Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 10+2 and at least 5 years service as Process Server (2 posts) or as another Class-IV employee (1 post) working in the Chamba Division. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open only to officials working in the Chamba Division. Promotion by way of selection under the Himachal Pradesh District Judiciary Staff (Recruitment, Promotion, Control, Conduct, Discipline and Other Conditions of Service) Rules, 2022. The 2 posts from Process Servers are meant for Bailiff.

faq.answer: Persons not working as Process Server or Class-IV employee in this Division. Officials with less than 5 years service in the feeder cadre.
